items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Caesar Dameron was in that band in Cleveland... Caesar was alto saxophone player of the band.

ctx.x: How did Clark know you? How did you know Clark?

Well, I guess he had heard of me because he heard that I was working at the Cedar Gardens. Everybody knows everybody in the business, you know? Caesar Dameron was in that band in Cleveland. I think Caesar knew George Clark.
What was the rest of that band?
